name: open-helpers
description: Shared post-open view-mode helper. customJS.OpenHelpers.forceActiveLeafPreview() flips the active markdown leaf, and forceLeafPreview(leaf) flips a leaf captured at call time, to reading mode after a create-and-open dispatch — deferred one macrotask + guarded (markdown-only, never throws, skips kanban/board leaves). Routes every new-note create path to read mode so notes never open in edit-with-title-selected. v0.1.1 adds forceLeafPreview(leaf) + cold-load optional-chaining at call sites (sauce v0.120.3).
